about: Hand-picked places that get a storefront sign, a map label and a star on the minimap, even if OpenStreetMap doesn't have them (or they've since closed). Placed where they were around 2014-2016. Position comes from `osm` (an OpenStreetMap node id in data/<area>.osm.json) if given, else `lat`/`lon`. A place with neither is listed but not drawn. `precision`: 'building' = the exact spot, 'block' = the centre of the address block (GSI address search), so it may be off by up to ~50 m. Add more by appending to `places` and running `npm run map:build`.

places.note: Craft beer bar in a basement on Gaien-Higashi-dori (外苑東通り), a minute from the crossing toward Tokyo Tower.
